div.span: every project starts with a folder and a dream
my dad wanted to control the hot tub on his phone. so i built it.
i write docs because future-me is grateful
it started as a keychain. it now has a docker backend.
my home lab has more uptime than most startups
wanted to check departures. ended up writing a captive portal.
still learning. always building.
started simple. added docker. you know how it goes.
i spent hours on OBS overlays i never go live with
i added OTA updates. then a web portal. then...
i told myself i'd keep it simple this time
yes, those are different overlays. yes, i made them myself.
open hardware should be for everyone
i have too many open tabs and half-finished PCBs

the readme is longer than the actual project
the hot tub still works btw
i have a poker game running in docker. don't ask why.
full-stack, bottom to top
it compiles. mostly.
the first version was worse. that's the point.
streams are live. overlays are custom. send help.
good tools make people faster. i try to build good tools.
that feeling when the e-ink refreshes exactly right
yes those OBS scenes have custom animated backgrounds. i made them.
i write firmware. also the backend. also the frontend.
the LED blinks. we ship it.

happiest when there's solder in the air
the PCB is fine. probably.

powered by energy drinks and a concerning amount of open tabs
